card.capacity_status_quote: A way to think about this is that, in spite of the capacity expansion we are pursuing, we see ourselves being essentially sold out in terms of capacity for the foreseeable future.
card.demand_direction_quote: Q1 book-to-bill came in above 2, and one-year backlog increased 70% from the prior quarter, closing at $300.6 million.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We expect Q2 revenues of nearly $126 million and 2026 revenues of nearly $570 million.
card.constraint_owner_quote: Fundamentally, in spite of capacity expansions, we expect to remain capacity constrained for a substantial timeframe
